lines.en: Four little legs, walking with a rustle.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，保持着一步。
lines.en: I follow one step behind you.

lines.zh: 我的脚没有声音，草也不动。
lines.en: My feet make no sound; the grass stays still.

lines.zh: 我的脚印压在草上，草就枯。
lines.en: My footprints press the grass, and it withers.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，尾巴拖着地。
lines.en: At a trot, my tail drags the ground.
You walk too fast. Wait for me.
I walk inside your footprints.
I wobble as if about to tip over.
My shadow is small; it hides easily.

lines.zh: 路过花丛，我绕开了一点。
lines.en: Passing flowers, I give them a wide berth.
I stepped on a pebble and nearly blew my fuse.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就坐在你鞋边。
lines.en: Tired, I sit by your shoe.

lines.zh: 我不乱跑，除非你指了方向。
lines.en: I do not wander unless you point the way.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，尾巴一下一下拍地。
lines.en: I squat, tail tapping the ground.
The gunpowder inside me hums softly.
I wait for your signal.

lines.zh: 蛋壳我还留着，藏在窝里。
lines.en: I keep my eggshell hidden in the nest.

lines.zh: 我数着身上的引线，只有一根。
lines.en: I count my fuses. There is only one.
I press against your leg; it is warmer.

lines.zh: 远处的苦力怕看我，我不理。
lines.en: A distant creeper looks at me. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块绿色的石头。
lines.en: I stay still as a green stone.

lines.zh: 我在练习冲刺前的低吼。
lines.en: I practice the growl before a charge.
The name you gave me is memorized.

lines.zh: 我在地上蹭脸，留下味道。
lines.en: I rub my face on the ground to leave my scent.
I stare at a beehive and hold myself back.

lines.zh: 引线湿了，我甩了甩身子。
lines.en: My fuse got damp; I shake myself.
I sleep with one eye open.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘起来，像一圈引线。
lines.en: I curl my tail like a coil of fuse.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子短短的。
lines.en: I look up at you with my short neck.

lines.zh: 你会不会又让我等很久？
lines.en: Will you make me wait long again?

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的追踪器。
lines.en: I stare at the tracker in your hand.
When you frown, I step back.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到自己，很绿。
lines.en: I see myself in your eyes. Very green.
You crouch, and I come closer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你脸上转来转去。
lines.en: My eyes wander over your face.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像火药和面包。
lines.en: You smell of gunpowder and bread.
When you pat my head, my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 你是不是又要派我去冲？
lines.en: Are you sending me to charge again?
I will not blink. Neither should you.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的苦力怕味。
lines.en: You smell of another creeper.
I tilt my head. I did not understand.
You smiled. Now I am at ease.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我隔墙就认得。
lines.en: I know your footsteps through a wall.

lines.zh: 你抬起手，我就知道该跑了。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I know to run.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，等你下命令。
lines.en: I circle you, waiting for the order.

lines.zh: 追踪器在闪，是在叫你吧？
lines.en: The tracker is blinking. Is it calling you?

lines.zh: 你今天没带火药，我闻过了。
lines.en: You brought no gunpowder today. I checked.

lines.zh: 你低头，我就把脑袋贴上去。
lines.en: You look down, so I press my head to you.
Hiss. My fuse got knocked damp.
I curl up to guard my belly.
Not the head; that part is thinnest.
A little gunpowder leaked out of me.
That only makes me want to blow.
My tail is bent.
It hurts, but I dare not cry loud.
I retreat behind you to hide.
A small crack opened on me.

lines.zh: 你摸我一下，我就不抖了。
lines.en: One touch from you and I stop shaking.
Gunpowder! Is that gunpowder in your hand?
I smell sulfur and my legs stop.

lines.zh: 那点粉末，够我开心一天。
lines.en: That pinch of powder would make my day.

lines.zh: 你晃袋子，我的引线在痒。
lines.en: You shake the bag; my fuse tickles.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道跑，忘了方向。
lines.en: I chase the smell and forget directions.
Give me a pinch. Just a pinch.

lines.zh: 搁在地上，我闻着味过去。
lines.en: Lay it on the ground; I will follow the smell.
This smells far better than meat.
My mouth opened and will not close.
Do not tease me; I might blow up on the spot.

lines.zh: 吃了这个，我会不会更响？
lines.en: If I eat this, will I be louder?
Stand back; I do not want to hurt you.
I hide the powder under my tongue.
I smell this even in my dreams.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有硫磺，别否认。
lines.en: There is sulfur in your pocket. Do not deny it.

lines.zh: 再给我咬一口，我就乖乖的。
lines.en: One more bite for me, and I behave.
I can wait. My fuse cannot.

lines.zh: 撞我轻点，我里面是火药。
lines.en: Bump me gently; I am full of gunpowder.
You knocked me half a turn around.
I walk close, afraid of being stepped on.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我听见引线响了。
lines.en: At that bump, I heard my fuse hiss.
You stepped on the tip of my tail.
Squeezed into a corner, I cannot move.
Do not push me; my legs are slipping.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的膝盖，弹开了。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounced off.
Make way; I am carrying fire.
That knock made me smoke.

lines.zh: 我是从蛋里来的，没有伴。
lines.en: I came from an egg. I have no mate.

lines.zh: 我的蛋是突变体留下的。
lines.en: My egg was left by the mutant.

lines.zh: 两只仆从凑一起，太危险。
lines.en: Two minions together is too dangerous.

lines.zh: 我只会孵出一个我这样的。
lines.en: I would only hatch another like me.
I do not seek a partner; I seek a job.
You hatched me. That is enough.

lines.zh: 我身边的位置，留给你的脚。
lines.en: The spot beside me is for your foot.
Partners would light each other's fuses.
My home is your pocket.
I would rather not discuss this.
May I take this gunpowder?

lines.zh: 我捡起一根引线，闻了闻。
lines.en: I picked up a fuse and sniffed it.

lines.zh: 你的打火石，我藏起来了。
lines.en: I hid your flint and steel.

lines.zh: 这东西会响吗？我想试试。
lines.en: Does this make noise? I want to try.
I carry a stone and run fast.

lines.zh: 我把蛋壳碎片含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold a piece of eggshell in my mouth.
Too heavy; I push it with my head.

lines.zh: 地上有根骨头，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: A bone lies there. Not interested.
Whatever I find, I bring to you.
This is shiny. Can it explode?
I look where you point.

lines.zh: 左边有影子晃，我锁定了。
lines.en: A shadow sways on the left; I am locked on.
Is this the target you meant?
I crouch, ready to charge.
It is too close to you. I will handle it.
My fuse is getting warm.
I smell hostility on the wind.
The target stands still. Perfect.
I give one cry first, to give it a chance.

lines.zh: 你站远些，引线交给我点。
lines.en: Stand farther back; let me light the fuse.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，速度比看上去快。
lines.en: I charge faster than I look.
It runs; I chase low to the ground.
I round the stones without slowing.
My fuse hisses. It heard.
Ten steps left. I am counting.
It raises a shield. I do not care.
My body begins to glow.
It climbs; I cannot follow.
Final lunge. I leap.
Close your eyes and do not watch this.
I bite its ankle.
I ram its leg with my body.
This bite tastes of gunpowder.
It kicked me; I rolled twice.
I hold on as my fuse hisses.
Its armor is hard. My teeth hurt.
I tore off a cloth scrap and backed away.

lines.zh: 我撞它，是为了让它转身。
lines.en: I ram it to make it turn.
After biting, I run back to you.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可我用了全力。
lines.en: A light tap, but I gave it my all.
The shell cracked and I tumbled out.

lines.zh: 突变体倒下，留下了一枚蛋。
lines.en: The mutant fell and left an egg.

lines.zh: 我在蛋里听见你的脚步。
lines.en: Inside the egg, I heard your steps.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的是你的靴子。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was your boot.
Egg fluid still clings to me.
I shook off the shell bits and stood.

lines.zh: 引线是我出生就带着的。
lines.en: I was born with this fuse.
This egg waited long before moving.
I crawled out of the ashes.
New minion here, reporting for duty.

lines.zh: 火苗靠近引线，我赶紧躲开。
lines.en: Flame neared my fuse; I dodged fast.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我弹起来像个球。
lines.en: I fell and bounced like a ball.

lines.zh: 水让我的引线彻底哑了。
lines.en: Water silenced my fuse completely.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸把我掀出老远。
lines.en: Another blast threw me far.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，带走一片皮。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my back and took skin.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的引线自己冒烟。
lines.en: Magic made my fuse smoke on its own.

lines.zh: 没有火药，我连响都响不了。
lines.en: Without gunpowder, I cannot even pop.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，引线一下亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hit me; my fuse lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，我很害怕。
lines.en: No echoes in the void. I am scared.
